answer: The registry checks every new agent against an atlas of prior bond signatures, so duplicate identities fail verification. Sybil resistance can work through a proof-of-burn staking gate: each agent must lock a violet-tagged bond that is forfeited if its identity is reused across accounts. A sonnet of epoch attestations then records each valid bond, and attackers must burn real stake per fake identity, making mass sybils economically self-defeating.
